description: Source code for web configuration database handling, including functions for initializing, decoding, encoding, and managing web configuration data structures, blobs, and file I/O.

methods.name: initDB
methods.description: Initializes the database by reading from a file, decoding msgpack data, and generating the internal blob.

methods.name: addNewDocEntry
methods.description: Packs the current web configuration data and persists it to a database file.

methods.name: generateBlob
methods.description: Creates a packed blob of web configuration data structures.

methods.name: writeToDBFile
methods.description: Writes data to a specified database file.

methods.name: decodeData
methods.description: Decodes msgpack data into web configuration database structure.

methods.name: decodeBlobData
methods.description: Decodes msgpack data into blob structure.

methods.name: get_DB_BLOB_base64
methods.description: Returns base64-encoded string of the database blob, with debug info.

methods.name: get_DB_BLOB
methods.description: Returns the current database blob, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: get_global_db_node
methods.description: Returns the global web configuration database node.

methods.name: set_global_db_node
methods.description: Sets the global web configuration database node.

methods.name: get_global_tmp_node
methods.description: Returns the global temporary data node.

methods.name: set_global_tmp_node
methods.description: Sets the global temporary data node.

methods.name: reset_db_node
methods.description: Resets the global database node to NULL.

methods.name: get_numOfMpDocs
methods.description: Returns the number of multipart documents.

methods.name: set_numOfMpDocs
methods.description: Sets the number of multipart documents.

methods.name: reset_numOfMpDocs
methods.description: Resets the multipart document count to zero.

methods.name: get_successDocCount
methods.description: Returns the count of successfully processed documents.

methods.name: reset_successDocCount
methods.description: Resets the success document count to zero.

methods.name: get_doc_fail
methods.description: Returns the document failure flag.

methods.name: set_doc_fail
methods.description: Sets the document failure flag.

methods.name: addToTmpList
methods.description: Creates and adds temporary document nodes based on multipart docs.

methods.name: checkDBList
methods.description: Checks and updates the database list with a document and version.

methods.name: updateDBlist
methods.description: Updates the database list with new version and root string.

methods.name: updateTmpList
methods.description: Updates temporary list entries with new status, version, error info.

methods.name: deleteFromTmpList
methods.description: Deletes a document node from the temporary list.

methods.name: delete_tmp_list
methods.description: Deletes all temporary document nodes.

methods.name: delete_tmp_docs_list
methods.description: Deletes all non-root documents from temporary list based on sync type.

methods.name: release_success_docs_tmplist
methods.description: Removes all successfully processed documents from temporary list.

methods.name: checkTmpRootUpdate
methods.description: Updates the root document version in temporary list if needed.

methods.name: process_webcfgdbparams
methods.description: Converts msgpack map into webconfig_db_data_t structure.

methods.name: process_webcfgdb
methods.description: Processes msgpack array into webconfig_db_data_t linked list.

methods.name: addToDBList
methods.description: Adds a webconfig_db_data_t node to the global list.

methods.name: get_DB_BLOB_base64
methods.description: Returns base64 string of the database blob with debug info.

methods.name: process_webcfgdbblobparams
methods.description: Processes msgpack map into blob_data_t structure.

methods.name: process_webcfgdbblob
methods.description: Processes msgpack array into blob_struct_t structure.

methods.name: base64blobencoder
methods.description: Encodes blob data into base64 string.

methods.name: writebase64ToDBFile
methods.description: Writes base64 data to specified file.

methods.name: getTmpNode
methods.description: Retrieves a temporary document node by name.

methods.name: updateFailureTimeStamp
methods.description: Updates retry timestamp for a document node.
